status: PENDING APPROVAL: 20261110062504_hod_staff_workload_summary and 20261110170000_rls_read_speedup have not been applied to production.

changeSummary.20261110062504_hod_staff_workload_summar: Adds a read-only, HOD-authorized staff workload aggregate across departments. It returns member names, departments and counts, not task records, and does not alter existing task visibility.
changeSummary.20261110170000_rls_read_speedup: Speeds up reads of aitask_entities by evaluating row security once per statement instead of once per row. Adds three private helper functions (aitask_rls_member_context, aitask_rls_visible_entities, aitask_rls_service_clients) and alters only the USING clause of the two read policies 'members can read scoped entities' and 'PM service records stay in portfolio'. Access rules are unchanged: the existing decision functions still make every decision. The migration records what each login can read before and after and aborts if any row differs.
